messages:
rachel: Noticed a weird correlated spike: after the scheduled KMS/HSM rotation + firewall rule tighten, a subset of GPU nodes in the warm pool fail to complete keystore handshake. Autoscaler reports join timeout. sample from node-init logs:
```
2026-03-25T11:02:51Z node-init ERROR keystore: decrypt failed: AccessDenied (KMS:Decrypt)
2026-03-25T11:02:53Z warmup WARN join attempt 4 -> backoff
2026-03-25T11:02:55Z net DEBUG natgw conntrack: conntrack table full, dropping new
```
Observed in us-east-1 and ca-central. Any recent egress/privatelink changes?

marco: yes, we tightened egress ACLs yesterday to block non-approved privatelink IP ranges. HSM/KMS privatelink endpoints are used but keystore clients create ephemeral ENIs in the keystore-subnet which weren't included in the allowlist.

vishal: Also seeing NATGW CPU spike + conntrack saturations. Many keystore clients retry on 5xx -> auditshipper floods S3 with PUT retries. Audit billing could jump if not mitigated.

nina: ops-bot alerted earlier: gpu-warmup-failure-rate > 6% (15m). I've paged oncall.

ops-bot: ALERT: keystore-handshake-latency P95 > 45s across warm pools (15m).

rachel: Root cause hypothesis: KMS rotation caused keystore proxy restarts and session re-establishments. New sessions from ephemeral ENIs hit deny list (SG/ACL), causing decrypts to fail and clients to fallback via NATGW, which saturates conntrack. That explains both AccessDenied and conntrack drops.

marco: mitigation options: 1) temporarily add SG egress rule scoped to keystore ENI CIDRs (10.248.64.0/22) for 443 with TTL 60m 2) add privatelink service name to allowlist (if supported) 3) bump NATGW scale & conntrack (costly) 4) relax IAM condition (last resort).

vishal: I prefer (1)+ (2). Least blast radius. Also flip auditshipper to 30% sampling to reduce S3 PUT storm. Cost estimate: new warm nodes to cover failures ~ $3.5k/day/region, extra NATGW capacity ~ $2k/day if we go that route. Sampling saves ~ $2.8k/day.

nina: CLI snippet for SG egress (will tag and scope):
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0d1e2f3a --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.248.64.0/22 --description "temp allow keystore ENIs" 
```
I'll open an infra PR with revert TTL and link to KMS runbook.

rachel: Add a targeted healthprobe to the warm-pool that retries keystore decrypt once bypassing audit exporter (so we don't generate PUTs during fix). Also ensure the PR includes tests that simulate rotation.

ops-bot: action: audit-sampler -> 30% (deploy id ds-2211). warmpool scale +1 in us-east and ca-central for 45m.

marco: Terraform PR created: platform/infra#987 - keystore-privatelink-exception ttl=1h, revert-checkbox, link to this thread. Included a canary that attempts `kms:Decrypt` from a tagged ENI before apply.

vishal: After SG change + sampler flip, decrypt latencies dropped to ~180ms in staging and prod canaries passed. conntrack pressure reduced, NATGW CPU normalized. Leaving monitoring window open 1h.

rachel: Followups: update KMS rotation runbook to pre-seed privatelink allowlist with keystore ENI ranges, add an automated pre-rotation canary, and include audit-sampler rollback steps. Please add postmortem notes to the rotation page. Thanks all :thumbsup:

audit-bot: NOTE: linked PR platform/infra#987 and rotation-runbook#keystore-2026-03-25 in thread metadata.
